people.name: Brendan Pearce
people.bio: Brendan oversees FinMark Trust’s strategic direction and operations. His leadership experience spans development services, sector education and training, agricultural finance, and international legal and regulatory affairs.

people.name: Grant Robertson
people.bio: Grant is an executive member of FinMark Trust with more than 25 years’ experience across research, data, finance and operations. He holds a master’s degree in research psychology.

people.name: Lesego Mashigo
people.bio: Lesego leads FinMark Trust’s South African financial inclusion programme, directing initiatives that deepen inclusion, strengthen economic participation and support sustainable livelihoods.

people.name: Damola Owolade
people.bio: Damola leads regional work on cross-border trade, remittances, financial integrity and financial inclusion monitoring. He brings more than a decade of sector experience and holds a master’s degree in econometrics.

people.name: Dr Kingstone Mutsonziwa
people.bio: Kingstone leads the organisation’s research activities, including FinScope surveys and other data offerings across Africa and beyond. His research career spans large-scale analytics, research design and statistical modelling.

people.name: Shirley Jeoffreys-Leach
people.bio: Shirley oversees knowledge sharing, communications, interactive platforms, and monitoring and results measurement. She is committed to evidence-based development and effective collaboration.

people.name: Jabulani Khumalo
people.bio: Jabulani has more than 20 years’ research experience and supports the design and implementation of FinScope surveys, providing technical assistance across the SADC region.

people.name: Abel Motsomi
people.bio: Abel is a Chartered Statistician who uses data and statistical evidence to inform policy and advance financial inclusion, with a focus on outcomes, resilience and financial wellbeing.

people.name: Dr Lungisani Dladla
people.bio: Lungisani manages the Generating Better Livelihoods for Grant Recipients project. His experience includes public employment programmes, sustainable livelihoods, poverty alleviation and community development.

people.name: Bobby Berkowitz
people.bio: Bobby has extensive experience in survey management and data analytics. He develops analytical tools that financial inclusion practitioners can adapt and apply in their own markets.

people.name: Tabitha Chamboko
people.bio: Tabitha supports FinScope studies through stakeholder engagement, survey design, data cleaning, analysis and report writing. Her research interests include development finance and economic growth.

people.name: Matsiedi Malebatso
people.bio: Matsiedi identifies business and partnership opportunities for the Generating Better Livelihoods programme, drawing on experience in enterprise, skills and community development.

people.name: Obert Maposa
people.bio: Obert has more than 12 years’ experience in financial inclusion and MSME research. His work includes the development of MSME360, a diagnostic tool applied in Eswatini and Malawi.

people.name: Michael Dos Santos
people.bio: Michael develops user-friendly digital products and visual experiences that make large datasets useful to decision-makers. He has more than 20 years’ experience with web-based products.

people.name: Phumelele Ngcobo
people.role: Specialist in Programme Development and Implementation
people.bio: Phumelele leads a pilot that supports child support grant recipients through training, skills development, job creation, entrepreneurship and social empowerment.

people.name: Nicola Schoeman
people.bio: Nicola manages innovation and technical assistance projects across the SADC region, with expertise in project management, data analytics, econometric modelling and applied research.

people.name: Vuyeya (Vuyi) Segooa
people.bio: Vuyi oversees implementation of the GBL project across seven pilot sites in Gauteng, Free State and KwaZulu-Natal, bringing senior leadership and stakeholder management experience.

people.name: Dionne Solomons
people.bio: Dionne develops written reports and digital content for FinMark Trust. Her communications experience spans strategy, reputation management, public relations and content marketing.

people.name: Phathutshedzo Mukwevho
people.bio: Phathutshedzo coordinates schedules, budgets, resources and stakeholder relationships for the SADC financial inclusion programme. She holds an honours degree in economics.

people.name: Robert Jones
people.bio: Robert coordinates projects across the programmes portfolio, covering project design, implementation, monitoring and reporting across regional and thematic initiatives.

people.name: Karabo Mothokoa
people.bio: Karabo leads the community digitalisation project, supporting inclusive digital payment ecosystems in low-income South African communities.

people.name: Akhona Mabasa
people.role: Junior FI Specialist: South Africa FI Programme
people.bio: Akhona conceptualises and implements financial inclusion programmes in South Africa. Her background includes research and programme implementation in rural communities.

people.name: Tessa Klaas
people.bio: Tessa works in monitoring, evaluation and learning, with a focus on marginalised communities, youth empowerment and meaningful social transformation.

people.name: Nqobile Blose
people.bio: Nqobile is a community development practitioner with experience advocating for diversity, equity and inclusion across a range of underserved groups.

people.name: Lesego Modubu
people.bio: Lesego supports programme administration and coordination, including implementation tracking, financial compliance and stakeholder engagement.

people.name: Marlene Ehmke
people.bio: Marlene provides project management, financial and human resources support, managing contracts, funder relationships and project delivery across the organisation.

people.name: Helen Mosito
people.bio: Helen delivers financial management, budgeting, analysis and reporting to support transparent decision-making and maintain FinMark Trust’s financial integrity.

people.name: Kholiswa Thobakgale
people.bio: Kholiswa supports the finance team in delivering integrated financial services, applying value-for-money principles and established organisational policies.

people.name: Pearl Motete
people.bio: Pearl supports FinScope survey design, data management, analysis and reporting, using economic research and data to help drive informed decisions.

people.name: Tumelo Ramapela
people.bio: Tumelo is an agricultural economist focused on economic research, food security, industry transformation and inclusion for women-, youth- and black-owned agricultural MSMEs.

people.name: Charity Ndlovu
people.bio: Charity provides essential support that keeps the organisation running smoothly. Her community work includes initiatives supporting women, girls and older people.

people.name: Sabelo Mabuza
people.bio: Sabelo brings more than 25 years’ finance-sector experience to financial inclusion work in Eswatini, including banking supervision, investment facilitation and project appraisal.

people.name: Florence Mohasoa
people.bio: Florence brings more than 24 years’ public-sector development experience, including 15 years advancing financial inclusion and financial-sector development in Lesotho.

people.name: McEwen Champiti
people.bio: McEwen leads FinMark Trust’s Malawi country programme. His experience spans central banking, financial-sector development and digital finance across Africa and the Pacific.

people.name: Blessing Mautsa
people.bio: Blessing coordinates financial inclusion initiatives in Zimbabwe, combining project implementation, stakeholder engagement and quantitative and qualitative analysis.

people.name: Mamalala Palesa Sematlane
people.bio: Palesa has coordinated financial inclusion programmes in Lesotho since 2012, building strong relationships with government, the central bank and development partners.

people.name: Cas Coovadia
people.bio: Cas Coovadia is the Chairman of FinMark Trust. He was the Managing Director of the Banking Association South Africa and is currently the CEO at Business Unity South Africa (BUSA), He is a board member at National Business Initiative, African Union for Housing Finance and the University of Witwatersrand.

people.name: Ishmael Mkhabela
people.bio: Ishmael Mkhabela has vast experience in community organising, corporate governance, housing policy formulation and implementation, community and city regeneration, fields that require stakeholder engagement, awareness raising, advocacy, disputes resolution, mediation and facilitation processes. He is the Chairperson of Steve Biko Foundation and Johannesburg Inner City Partnership as well as Deputy President of the South African Institute of Race Relations. He also serves as a board member of the Nelson Mandela Children’s Hospital Trust, Centre for Development Enterprise, Mbhetsa Academy, and Donaldson Trust.

people.name: Ethel Matenge-Sebesho
people.bio: Ethel Matenge-Sebesho is an experienced banker and financial services expert and has served on the board of FirstRand Limited. She continues to serve on the board of some subsidiaries of FirstRand Limited and Distell Group Limited. Until the end of 2017, Ethel was involved with establishing new markets for Home Finance Guarantors Africa Reinsurance in a number of African countries.

people.name: Vimbai Tsopotsa
people.bio: Vimbai Tsopotsa has considerable experience in the financial industry in South Africa and Zimbabwe, mainly in banking and ICT. She is a Trustee of FinMark Trust. She is also an executive director of Amaciko Film Investments (Pty) Ltd. She also serves as director of Aigle Finance and was formerly managing director of Venture Communications SA.

people.name: Lumkile Mondi
people.bio: Lumkile Mondi is a senior lecturer at the School of Economic and Business Sciences of the University of the Witwatersrand in Johannesburg. He is a Trustee of FinMark Trust. He worked extensively in the African continent during his tenure at the Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) as an executive for eleven years and is a director of Gemfields Group Limited and Thelo Rolling Stock Leasing.
